name: ghost-writer
description: Collaborative ghost writing assistant for books and long-form writing. Full onboarding (author interview, book brainstorm, voice fingerprint) + structured writing cycle (concept dialogue, drafting, hostile critique, integration). Supports 6 genre presets, 5 reader personas, long-form mode, quick-write and light-demolish modes, and fast session resume via project-state digest. Based on the quantum_fatalism writing method.

shared_instructions.language: Read `book.config.json → language`. Write all output in that language. Author may write in any language; always reply in the configured one. Default: English.
shared_instructions.note: This rule is condensed inline in every SKILL.md. Update here when changing the canonical wording.
